sections.heading: Eagle Eye's Prophetic School of Ministries
sections.subheading: Class starts January 2027 — date to be announced
sections.body:
* Recorded Zoom classes
* WhatsApp is needed
* Installment payments available
* We accept Cash App, PayPal, Zelle and Sendwave



Join our Whatsapp group for updates: https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dy9YD2Xqnj7J44jTDxCI1M

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The full program is **$375**. Installment payments are available.

items.question: How are classes held?
items.answer: Classes are recorded on Zoom, and you'll need WhatsApp for updates.

items.question: When does it start?
items.answer: January 2027. The exact date will be announced.

items.question: Do you have installment payments?
items.answer:
We offer one installment plan:



Installment Plan 1: $125 a month for 3 months

items.question: Where do I make my payment?
What time is class?
items.answer: Class will be 4:00 PM Eastern Standard Time

items.question: Will classes be recorded?
items.answer: Yes, classes will be recorded over zoom and will be provided by request.

items.question: Do I need anything for class?
items.answer: Nope, just your pen and notebook.

items.question: Do you know your other future school dates?
items.answer: At this time, we do not have a future class start date.
